newsitem.title: USA: BPA makes no peak firm power offers for Monday.
newsitem.headline: BPA makes no peak firm power offers for Monday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said Friday it was not offering peak firm power for Monday delivery, although peak firm power was available through the weekend.
For Monday, BPA's price for firm power during light load hours was $9.00 for both the Northwest and the California Oregon Border (COB).

BPA Monday prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT were set at $7.00 for Northwest and $8.00 at COB. Non-firm power during hours ending 0600, 0700 and 2300 PDT was unchanged at $10.00.
Peak firm power for Saturday was set at $13.00 for Northwest and $15.00 for COB, while light-load firm power was set at $9.00 for both Northwest and COB.
BPA Saturday prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0700 and 2300-2400 PDT were set at $7.00 for Northwest and $8.00 at COB.
Non-firm power during hours ending 0800-2200 was set at $14.00 at Northwest and $16.00 at COB.
Peak firm power for Sunday was set at $11.00 for Northwest and $13.00 for COB, while light-load firm power was set at $9.00 for both Northwest and COB.

BPA Sunday prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0800 and 2300-2400 PDT were set at $7.00 for Northwest and $8.00 at COB. Non-firm power during hours ending 0900-2200, was set at $12.00 at Northwest and $14.00 at COB.
